definitions.gloss: at most; at the most; no more than
definitions.explanation: Sets an upper limit on a quantity or degree. Indicates the maximum possible amount.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くとも⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧だろう。
examples.english: It's probably ten people at most.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}くとも{五万円|ごまんえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The cost will come to 50,000 yen at most.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くとも⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{終|お}わる⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧だ。
examples.english: It should be finished in three days at most.

notes:
Sets an upper limit on a quantity. Formed from ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (many) in its く form + とも (even if). Literally "even if many."

USAGE:
Placed before the quantity being limited. More formal and written than ⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, which is the everyday spoken equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {多|おお}くとも + number: at most [number]
- {多|おお}くとも + time: at most [time period]

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: at most (casual, spoken)
- せいぜい: at most (casual, sometimes dismissive)
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at maximum (factual)
- ⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧とも: at least (sets a lower limit)
